domain: Passive 5.76–5.8 GHz Earth–Moon–Earth scattering and station practice

criteria.evidence: Clear passive EME path identity, observables, and transfer limits; equations distinguish bistatic and monostatic cases.
criteria.next: Correct author/title attribution and retain full-text access limitation.

criteria.evidence: Correct extended-target integral and source-matched 7.209 GHz link calculation; independent result reproduces Pr and the paper's noise estimator.
criteria.gap: No complete conditional 5.76–5.8 GHz received-power/C/N0 budget with cross-section, receiver noise, and an integrated beam factor. Missing deployment inputs do not prevent a labeled illustrative case.
criteria.next: Add conditional target-band reference budget and cross-section/noise/beam sensitivities.

criteria.evidence: Compares point, uniform, Hagfors, composite, ephemeris, and fading-only alternatives with qualitative failure conditions.
criteria.gap: No normalized angular kernel, quantitative diffuse/polarization law, or calculated discriminator among candidate shapes; the measured 0.06 local albedo is not reported.
criteria.next: Compare a source-backed classical angular/delay law and a bounded alternative under matched normalization.

criteria.evidence: Correctly separates 2.56 s bulk delay from 11.564 ms finite-distance geometric support and does not call support a PDP.
criteria.gap: No delay-power quantiles, explicit surface/projected-area convention, or beam-weighted profile check; these are feasible from classical measurements even though 5.8 GHz PDP data are absent.
criteria.next: Reproduce a classical delay curve/table, calculate defined quantiles, and state its wavelength/beam transfer limits.

criteria.evidence: Correctly labels 35/90 Hz as 7.2 GHz, DE436-derived footprint widths, separates common shift and spread, and scales only conditionally.
criteria.gap: Omits measured approximately 40/90 Hz spectrum widths, 2/5 Hz resolution, and source definitions; no joint delay-Doppler law, PSD/correlation estimator, or target-band spectrum.
criteria.next: Report predicted and observed source widths separately with resolution and estimator, preserving the target-band gap.

criteria.evidence: Correctly describes two-leg path geometry, station-specific rates, and the DE436 source case.
criteria.gap: No independent retarded-geometry calculation or quantified geocentric/instantaneous approximation error. The cited source geometry/epoch allows a bounded check.
criteria.next: Run a small geometry check on the cited paper's stated station/epoch, or explicitly bound why available ephemeris inputs prevent it.

criteria.evidence: Explains OC/SC convention and distinguishes circular-channel ratios from antenna mismatch; bounds a one-off 10 GHz operator report.
criteria.gap: The cited primary source's measured 0.44/0.45 SC/OC ratios and 0.06 OC albedo are omitted; no target-band feed/Jones statistics exist.
criteria.next: Add measured local circular-channel values and footprint/calibration boundaries; do not promote them to universal 5.8 GHz coefficients.

criteria.evidence: Connects lunar noise to beam/phase, separates point-source pointing estimates from full-disc coupling, and reports one station's Moon-noise increase.
criteria.gap: No beam-fill/antenna-temperature calculation or dish-integrated lunar coupling; speckle/spatial correlation is qualitative.
criteria.next: Perform a conditional beam-fill and signal/noise comparison across representative apertures; label the model and temperature inputs.

criteria.evidence: Executes a conditional two-end P.838 rain calculation and preserves operational RFI examples without claiming availability.
criteria.gap: No gas/cloud/low-elevation or two-leg scintillation calculation; no weather-conditioned receiver/clock observations. Some site inputs are genuinely absent.
criteria.next: Add one standards-based gas/cloud sensitivity under stated conditions and preserve weather/dependence limits.

criteria.evidence: Useful simple-to-composite model alternatives and failure conditions; identifies existing native two-path reuse without calling it measured EME.
criteria.gap: No concrete cost/observable comparison for delay-Doppler surface, replay, or native receiver alternatives.
criteria.next: Compare a minimal structured kernel and replay by cost, observable, and receiver relevance; avoid builds.

criteria.evidence: Independent arithmetic matches the 7.2 GHz radar equation/SNR convention; official PDS record and useful primary observations are identified; exact-band source search is bounded and honestly limited.
criteria.gap: The report omits decisive accessible measurements from the 2020 paper and does not analyze a public numerical product/raw record. No matched full-disc 5–6 cm EME record was found.
criteria.next: Add the primary paper's observed spectrum/CPR/albedo/SNR results and a bounded recent X/C calibration-transfer check; retain the whole-disc target-band boundary.

criteria.evidence: Rain and interference sensitivities are explicit, failure causes are separated, and no natural occurrence probability is inferred.
criteria.gap: No matched downstream receiver discriminator or joint adverse/outage case preserving beam, noise, cross-section, weather, polarization and tracking dependence.
criteria.next: Specify one paired conditional stress and an outcome that would favor a channel or receiver choice; keep it synthetic.

depth_dimensions.regimes_and_observables: Partial: clear path and observable distinctions; target-band channel remains underdetermined.
depth_dimensions.literature_discovery: Partial: primary and official sources plus bounded searches; incorrect foundational attribution and omitted accessible primary measurements/recent calibration transfer.
depth_dimensions.alternatives_and_counterevidence: Partial: useful model alternatives and calibration/RFI counterevidence; measured near-band outputs and quantitative kernel contrasts are missing.
depth_dimensions.quantitative_interpretation: Partial: equations, units, estimator, and source-matched arithmetic are strong; target-band budget, PDP and polarization calculations remain.
depth_dimensions.executed_discriminators: Partial: link, geometry, pointing and rain checks executed; no public PDS raster/raw EME reanalysis and primary spectrum outputs are not carried into results.
depth_dimensions.decision_relevance: Partial: concrete operational dependencies and failure modes; no selected conditional target-band receiver budget or downstream falsifying outcome.

local_primary_access: Sun et al. 2020 PMC full text
